metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: Large Data Transfer to Cloud Storage
properties.description: Detect bulk data uploads to S3/Azure Blob/GCS from unusual sources
properties.query: CommonSecurityLog| where SentBytes > 5242880| where DestinationIP !startswith "10." and SourceIP !startswith "10."| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP, DestinationIP | where count_ > 5 // AZ-EXFILTRATION-158
